The happy farmer and his wife.
Once upon a time, there was a poor farmer called Fred.
He and his wife Doris lived in a small old house.
One day, a fairy visited them.
"Fred, I'd like to give you three wishes," said the fairy.
Fred and Doris smiled at each other and said,
"Thank you, but we don't need any wishes."
"I can give you some gold. Then you won't have to work," said the fairy.
"Thank you. We're poor, but we're happy," said Doris.
"I can give you a big new house," said the fairy.
"Thank you. Our house is small and old, but it's warm and nice,"
"I wish you a happy life," said the fairy.
Life was different in the past. Time went slowly, not so fast.
Children had fun all day long, running and jumping and singing a song.
Life is easy these days. Machines help in many ways.
Time goes fast, but it's okay. We still have lots of time to play.
